name: auth-form
description: Composes input, button, card into sign-in form; caller owns credentials, validation, submission state.
usage:
AuthForm(
    "Welcome back",
    identity: $email,
    identityError: emailError,
    password: $password,
    passwordError: passwordError,
    formError: formError,
    isSubmitting: isSubmitting,
    secondaryActionTitle: "Forgot password?",
    onSecondaryAction: { },
    onSubmit: { }
)
accessibility: Fields need accessibilityLabel = title (iOS 27: label+prompt alone shows placeholder, unnamed once typed).
Focus: identity, password. Next key: identity to password. Return: submits.
Invalid: not color alone; border increases; footnote under field is accessibility hint.
Errors post AccessibilityNotification.Announcement on change; unchanged skipped, caller MUST announce same-result; VoiceOver timing unverified.
Autofill fixed: identity .username (email/username), password .password; verify manually, saved credential.
isSubmitting: controls disabled, shared opacity; submit spinner, title as label.
